findings.description: The Lambda environment embeds an AWS access key ID and secret access key directly in Terraform. Environment variables and Terraform state can expose these credentials to users or processes with read access, enabling unauthorized AWS API access if the key is active.

The function uses nodejs12.x, an end-of-life runtime that no longer receives security updates. This leaves the function dependent on an unsupported execution environment with known or future unpatched vulnerabilities.
